Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the thorough draft. A few clarifications from Velaris side: 

- Badge process: we use an unattended kiosk in the lobby for general visitors that prints adhesive badges. For C-suite and escorted visitors we issue a paper lanyard badge at the security desk. We will pre-print badges if you provide the final attendee list by June 18.

- Demo devices: Personal devices are allowed on our visitor network but USB/external storage is prohibited without prior authorization from our security team.
- Docking: Mike (cc'd) manages dock access — standard freight window is 07:00–17:00 Mon–Fri.

Attached: velaris-badge-policy.pdf (short), vendor-delivery-guidelines.pdf (dock hours & coordinates).

Hi Redwood team —

Quick security notes from our operations group: 

- Photo ID: required for all on-site visitors. Government-issued ID preferred.
- Lanyards: we provide paper lanyards for C-suite only. No cloth or personal lanyards on secure floors.
- Electronic devices: allowed on guest SSID. Any demonstration involving external storage (USB/SSD) requires an approved exception and must be logged.
- Sign-in: electronic capture (tablet) preferred for audit trail; paper sign-in is acceptable as a fallback but must include ID type and phone number.
- Prohibited items: external network switches, unapproved access points, and unmanaged storage.

We also require the vendor security questionnaire completed and returned by June 15 so our information security team can review any potential risks. Questionnaire attached: vendor-security-questions.xlsx.

If you need escort names now we can provide a list of assigned escorts the week of June 22.

Regards,
Velaris Security Ops Team
